Name: MaxMyTV
Description:
MaxMyTV Smart Box sits between your TV and set-top box. It improves 2 areas of TV watching experience - 
Home Automation and Social TV.

Home Automation: 
Traditional HA solutions are expensive and hard to configure. Startups try to solve this with just a smartphone. But they only create a Personal Area Network. Sensors have to be present near the phone always which is not possible. Number of devices which can be connected is limited too. 
Solution: 
With Smartbox as a server at home you can control the devices anytime and take detailed analytics from sensors. Moreover the alerts from sensors and video from surveillance camera can be overlaid on the broadcast video. Even if the TV is turned off, it can be turned on using our smart power outlet.

Social TV: 
People interact on Social media while watching TV. But they have to shift focus from TV to smartphone making the experience disjointed. 
Solution: 
Instead of using a small phone to track Social media and scores, with MaxMyTV you can overlay them on broadcast video of TV.

Flour Mill Machine

Description:
C-Bot is transforming home automation with its smart, wireless curtain accessory designed for convenience and ease of use. Tired of outdated, manual curtain controls and expensive, complex systems?  C-Bot offers an affordable and simple solution.   

Our vision is to make home automation accessible and easier for a better lifestyle. C-Bot is a retrofit device, meaning it's designed for universal fit and can easily be mounted onto most existing commercial curtains without needing a dedicated power socket.   

Control your curtains effortlessly via the user-friendly C-Bot Android app, a web server, or even voice commands using virtual assistants like Alexa. C-Bot integrates advanced sensor technology, including temperature, light (LDR), sun, and accelerometer sensors, enabling smart features like:   

Smart Temperature Regulation: Automatically adjust curtains based on room vs. outdoor temperature to potentially conserve energy.   
Light Reactive Control: Open or close curtains based on ambient light or sunlight detection.   
Sun Automation: Schedule curtain movements based on local sunrise and sunset times.   
Accelerometer Control: Features like "pull and go" where a simple manual tug can initiate movement.   
Flexible Connectivity: Operates via Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, or both.   
Scheduling & Calibration: Set timers and precisely calibrate the opening/closing distance for your specific curtains.   

C-Bot makes smart curtain control simple, efficient, and accessible for everyone. Join us in making homes smarter, one curtain at a time.
